![](thumbnail.jpg)

Off and on, I blog about some personal projects and other tasks I do. I was looking for simple way to document my work, so I can refer back to it and if possible help others as well.

I started a blog site back in 2014 using [wordpress](https://scriptndebug.wordpress.com/). Since I was not hosting the wordpress website, thus, had couple of difficulties like maintenance was always an issue. I wanted a simple solution where I don't have to compile like Jekyll etc.

I moved to a simple [solution](https://kbroman.org/simple_site/pages/independent_site.html)  by [karl Broman](https://kbroman.org), it was amazing but over a period of time, I realized it is was too simple. Don't get it wrong, it works but the UI etc. might require some work to imrpove thus I started looking for an other solution. 

Few years back, I came across quarto and I think it will be enough for a blogging site (at least for now), it is simple and can easily be used with git pages. Yes, the site has to be build, but it is a small step I am willing to take toget a better looking blog. 

If anything here is confusing (or _wrong_!), or if I've missed important details, please [submit an issue](https://github.com/mnahmad/scriptndebug/issues).
